questions.explanation: Software Science (also known as Halstead Metrics) was developed and published by Maurice H. Halstead in 1977. The theory operates on the premise that any computer program is a collection of tokens categorized strictly into operators and operands.
questions.explanation_ar: Maurice Halstead طور نظرية Software Science عام 1977.

questions.question: ‘FAN IN’ of a component A is defined as
options_en: count of the number of components that can call, or pass control, to component A
number of components related to component A
number of components dependent on component A
options: count of the number of components that can call, or pass control, to component A
number of components related to component A
number of components dependent on component A

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.8; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Fan-in of a component $A$ is the count of the number of components that can call, or pass control, to component $A$. It measures how many other components depend on component $A$.
questions.question_ar: FAN IN للمكوّن A يعرف بأنه:
options_ar: عدد المكونات التي يمكنها استدعاء المكوّن A أو تمرير التحكم إليه
عدد المكونات المعتمدة على المكوّن A
questions.explanation_ar: FAN IN يقيس عدد المكونات التي تستدعي المكوّن A.

questions.question: ‘FAN OUT’ of a component A is defined as
options_en: number of components related to component A
number of components dependent on component A
number of components that are called by component A
options: number of components related to component A
number of components dependent on component A
number of components that are called by component A

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.9; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Fan-out of a component $A$ is the number of components that are called by component $A$. It reflects the control dispersion and coordination responsibility of the component.
questions.question_ar: FAN OUT للمكوّن A يعرف بأنه:
options_ar: عدد المكونات المعتمدة على المكوّن A
عدد المكونات التي يستدعيها المكوّن A
questions.explanation_ar: FAN OUT يقيس عدد المكونات التي يستدعيها المكوّن A.

questions.question: Which is not a size metric?

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.10; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Cyclomatic Complexity is a control-flow structural complexity metric formulated by Thomas McCabe, designed to quantify procedural logic and the number of linearly independent paths. It is not a measure of software physical or functional size. In contrast, LOC, Function count, and Halstead's Program Length are recognized size metrics.
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس مقياس حجم؟
questions.explanation_ar: cyclomatic complexity مقياس تعقيد وليس مقياس حجم.
